Package overview

Experience the true diversity of Kenya on this expertly curated 10-day safari by , combining remote northern reserves, iconic savannahs, scenic Rift Valley lakes, and the wildlife-rich parks of southern Kenya. This journey is thoughtfully paced to allow meaningful wildlife encounters while maintaining comfort and flexibility, with the option to end the safari in Nairobi or continue to the coast for a relaxing beach holiday in Mombasa or Diani.

  • Samburu National Reserve
  • Encounter rare northern species in Samburu, including Grevy’s zebra, Somali ostrich, and Beisa oryx
  • Predator Action: High chances of seeing lions, leopards, and cheetahs, often with dramatic kills, especially near the river
  • Elephant Herds: Large elephant populations gather at the Ewaso Ng'iro River, offering great viewing and bathing spectacles.
  • Birdwatching Paradise: Over 450 bird species, including the Vulturine Guineafowl and Martial Eagle, make it a top birding destination in Kenya.
  • Lake Nakuru National Park
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Lake Nakuru National Park is Kenya's first government-protected rhino sanctuary and a major highlight. It hosts one of the largest concentrations of the critically endangered Eastern black rhino and a thriving population of Southern white rhino
  • Rare Rothschild's Giraffe: The park is a sanctuary for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, which was translocated here for its protection.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Samburu

Morning departure from Nairobi heading north through central Kenya Scenic drive past Mt. Kenya region Arrive in Samburu for lunch and rest Afternoon game drive in Samburu National Reserve Overnight: Samburu lodge / tented camp Highlights: Reticulated giraffe, Grevy’s zebra, Somali ostrich, Ewaso Nyiro River

02Day 2 | Samburu Full Day

Early morning game drive Leisure time at the lodge Afternoon game drive exploring different parts of the reserve Overnight: Samburu lodge / tented camp

03Day 3 | Samburu - Lake Nakuru

Early breakfast and drive south through the Great Rift Valley Arrive at Lake Nakuru for lunch Afternoon game drive in the park Overnight: Lodge near Lake Nakuru Highlights: Flamingos, rhinos, Rothschild giraffe, scenic viewpoints

04Day 4 | Lake Nakuru - Masai Mara

Morning departure to Masai Mara Arrive in time for lunch Afternoon game drive in the reserve Overnight: Masai Mara lodge / tented camp

05Day 5 | Masai Mara Full Day

Morning game drive Optional cultural visit to a Maasai village Afternoon game drive Overnight: Masai Mara lodge / tented camp

06Day 6 | Masai Mara Full Day

Full day in the Mara with flexible game drives Option for picnic lunch inside the reserve Overnight: Masai Mara lodge / tented camp Highlights: Big Five, large predator population, open savannah landscapes

07Day 7 | Masai Mara - Lake Naivasha

Breakfast and drive to Lake Naivasha Lunch on arrival Afternoon boat ride (optional) or visit to Crescent Island / Hell’s Gate Overnight: Lake Naivasha lodge

08Day 8 | Lake Naivasha - Amboseli

Early departure heading south via Nairobi Arrive in Amboseli for lunch Afternoon game drive with Mt. Kilimanjaro views (weather permitting) Overnight: Amboseli lodge / tented camp

09Day 9 | Amboseli - Tsavo West

Morning game drive in Amboseli Drive to Tsavo West Visit Mzima Springs and lava flows Overnight: Tsavo West lodge

10Day 10 | Tsavo West - Nairobi/Beach Extension

fter breakfast, choose one of the following options: Option A: Return to Nairobi Drive back to Nairobi Drop-off at hotel or airport Option B: Beach Extension – Mombasa or Diani Drive to the train station or directly to the coast Connect to Mombasa or Diani Beach for a relaxing beach holiday Safari officially ends, beach stay arranged separately Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
